parent_experiment.reason_for_new_version: V52 selected an early doubled-capacity cycle when ordinary terminal cycles fell below a relative-to-maximum threshold.

development_scope: All seven already-accessed non-sealed CALCE protocol groups; former validation groups are development data and cannot be reused as blind evidence.

preprocessing.capacity_primary: Trapezoidal integral of negative current over time within each cycle, with nonnegative time steps no greater than 120 seconds.
preprocessing.diagnostic_cycle: Latest cycle in each operation block with integrated discharge capacity above 1e-6 Ah.
preprocessing.crosscheck: Compare integrated capacity with within-cycle Discharge_Ah range; retain relative disagreements above 0.02 as parser counterexamples.
preprocessing.normalization: Divide by the first valid diagnostic capacity for the same cell.
preprocessing.learner_visibility: Anonymous coordinates, controls, cell/group tokens, and normalized response only.

program_selection.search_language: same anonymous executable atom grammar frozen in the V52 Git commitment

sealed_success_conditions: program and parameters committed to Git before sealed archive download
sealed prediction RMSE ratio below 0.80 versus the best registered baseline without refit
selected program is finite and counterfactually sensitive to every control it claims
capacity-column and current-integral crosscheck does not change the conclusion
failure_conditions: any sealed access before the V52.1 program commitment
sealed prediction ratio at or above 0.80
parser ambiguity changes the pass/fail result
representation is a behavioral duplicate, identity, constant, or target proxy
claims_blocked: assigned-rate effect separated from internal heating
